description: This PHP source file defines an admin controller class `WorkshopSubController` within the Goteo project. The class manages CRUD operations for workshops, including editing, listing, and deleting workshop entries, with associated geolocation handling.

classes.name: WorkshopSubController
classes.description: Controller class handling admin actions for managing workshops, including editing, listing, adding, and removing workshop instances, with permission checks and location management.

methods.name: isAllowed
methods.description: Checks if the user has the necessary permissions (superadmin or root) on the master node.

methods.name: editAction
methods.description: Handles creating or updating a workshop and its location, processing POST data, validation, and saving changes.

methods.name: addAction
methods.description: Redirects to the 'edit' method to handle creation of a new workshop.

methods.name: listAction
methods.description: Returns a list of all workshops for display in an admin list view.

methods.name: removeAction
methods.description: Deletes a specified workshop from the database.
